title: dvt Dashboard Spec
description: Authoritative JSON Schema for a dvt dashboard spec. schemaVersion 1.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. Incremented on every breaking change; migration functions handle older specs.

id.description: Stable UUID. Matches dashboards.id in the metadata database.

panels.description: Ordered list of panels on the default (single-page) dashboard. Empty when using pages[].

pages.description: Multi-page dashboard. When present, each page carries its own layout + panels and is selected via the tab bar. The top-level layout/panels may be empty.

CachePolicy.description: Per-dashboard query-result cache policy (DVT-185). Controls how long this dashboard's query results may be served from the dvt cache before re-querying the warehouse. Omit for the org default. Results are cached only for identical (source, query, params, viewer-role) — they never cross identities.

ttlSeconds.description: Result-cache lifetime in seconds. 0 = always live (never cached). Clamped to the org's maximum TTL. Omit to use the org default (10 min).

enabled.description: When false, this dashboard always queries live (equivalent to ttlSeconds: 0), regardless of ttlSeconds. Defaults to true.

TokenRef.description: A token reference resolved at render time, e.g. "{chart.series.1}".

TokenValue.description: A literal token value (hex, number-as-string, font stack, etc.) or a TokenRef.

ColorTokenValue.description: A color-bearing token value: a TokenRef ({color.brand-indigo}), a hex/rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() literal, or a CSS named color. Deliberately excludes CSS-resource functions (url(), image-set(), …) — those reach inline style / ECharts and are an SSRF/exfil sink under the headless render service (ADR-0032 §2, ADR-0024). The server-side trust boundary for every color sink ADR-0032 §2 names: the edit tray's series-color control, the chart.series.N / .color / .background overrides, and the KPI/Stat/MetricStrip/Divider color fields. The control widget is UX only.

FieldColorRef.description: A field-value color reference (DVT-510, ADR-0044 §4). Reads the color for this slot from a named column in the same bound row. The column value is warehouse-controlled and runs through sanitizeBackground at render time (web/src/css-safety.ts) — a value that is not a safe color is dropped and the cell renders without that color slot. This gate is equivalent to the author-time ColorTokenValue pattern: field-sourced is no looser than a literal (ADR-0044 §7). Only permitted in CellStyle.fill and CellStyle.textColor (string vs object — disjoint oneOf, no overlap).

fromField.description: Name of a column in the same bound row whose value supplies this color. The value is sanitized at render time by sanitizeBackground (css-safety.ts) — a value that is not a safe color (hex/rgb/named/gradient/var()) is dropped and the cell renders without that color slot.

FontFamilyTokenValue.description: A font-family token value: a TokenRef ({typography.fontFamily}) or one of a CLOSED allow-set of font stacks (ADR-0032 §A3, DVT-294). A font stack has no safe-literal grammar (commas, spaces, arbitrary family names), so unlike a color it CANNOT be expressed as a pattern — it is an enum. This is the server-side gate for the `typography.fontFamily` / `*.family` token slots, which are read straight into React inline `style.fontFamily` (PanelContainer/HtmlPanel/HeroPanel/TextPanel/StatPanel/FilterPopover) — a NEW inline-style sink the color gate does NOT cover. The `.family`/`fontFamily` keys are routed here as a POSITIVE constraint that OVERRIDES the non-color `.size`/`.family`/… carve-out (which would otherwise route `.family` to loose TokenValue and defeat this enum). The dropdown control is UX; this enum is the enforcement. To add a face: add the stack here AND mirror to server/internal/spec/*.json via `make schema`.

enum: JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

ThemeTokenMap.description: A theme-token tier map (primitive/semantic/component). SECURITY (ADR-0032 §A3, DVT-294): theme tokens resolve into ECharts color slots and React inline `style` across EVERY panel, the same SSRF/exfil sink class (url()/image-set() under the headless renderer, ADR-0024) the element `overrides` gate closes — but for the theme map it was OPEN (loose TokenValue) before DVT-294. The gate is now the SAME default-deny carve-out shape as `overrides`: a `.family`/`fontFamily` key is the closed font-stack enum (FontFamilyTokenValue, a POSITIVE constraint that must override the non-color bucket below); a non-color dimensional/typographic suffix (.size/.shadow/.weight/.radius/.base/Gap/…) stays loose TokenValue; everything else (color slots: chart.series.N, *.color, *.background, text.*, color.*, page.*, panel.*) is a default-deny ColorTokenValue that rejects CSS-resource smuggling.

brief.description: One-line thesis shown as the dashboard subtitle.

findings.description: Key takeaways, surfaced in the documentation drawer.

readme.description: Full README (markdown) shown in the documentation drawer.

decisions.description: Notable design/analytical decisions, shown in the documentation drawer.

purpose.description: The decision or action this dashboard is meant to drive, written for its audience (DVT-249, ADR-0004 Amendment 1). One or two sentences. OPTIONAL in schema; the authoring/MCP-apply boundary emits a WARN provenance suggestion when it is absent on a 3+ panel dashboard. The schema never rejects a spec for missing it (older specs keep loading).

audience.description: Primary consumer of this dashboard (DVT-249). DRIVES generation, not just metadata (ADR-0004 Amendment 1): executive => compressed narrative, bigger key metrics, action-oriented titles, recommendation up top; analyst => denser data + richer exploration affordances; operator => monitoring/status readout with data-freshness emphasis. The enum is closed because each value carries a generation contract — adding a value is an ADR-0004 amendment, not a schema patch, so generation behavior never drifts undocumented.

keyQuestions.description: The questions this dashboard is designed to answer, in priority order (index 0 = the primary question). A panel cites the question it serves by ZERO-BASED INDEX via meta.panels[panelId].serves_question — an index, not the question text, so the reference stays stable when the wording is edited (DVT-249).

assumptions.description: Analytical assumptions recorded at authoring time (DVT-249). Each carries assertedBy (agent|human) + an optional validatedAt, so a reader can tell an agent's unverified assertion from a human-confirmed one.

conclusions.description: Findings/conclusions the dashboard supports, with provenance (DVT-249). Distinct from `findings` (free-text takeaways shown in the documentation drawer): a conclusion carries assertedBy + validatedAt. `findings`/`decisions` are unchanged and not renamed.

dataAsOf.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the most recent data this dashboard reflects (DVT-249). Author/agent-set. On a material data change the server sets documentationStale=true but PRESERVES this value (DVT-267), so a reader still sees when the data was last confirmed fresh; the author clears stale by setting a new dataAsOf.

documentationStale.description: Server-set freshness signal (DVT-267): true when a material data change (a panel's query / sourceId / metricRef / params changed) was detected since dataAsOf was last set, so the recorded purpose/assumptions/conclusions may no longer hold. Cleared when the author sets a fresh dataAsOf. Surfaced in dvt_dashboard_get / dvt_dashboard_search (DVT-250) so a reading agent can down-weight stale documentation. The dashboard-level flag is true when ANY panel is stale (see meta.panels[id].documentationStale).

panels.description: Per-panel provenance, keyed by panel id (DVT-249). Lives at MANIFEST scope here, NOT on the Panel/element schema: elements are independently versioned and reused across dashboards (ADR-0021), so element-scoped docs would carry a cross-dashboard staleness vector. Keys SHOULD match a panel id in panels[]/pages[*].panels[]; an orphan key is a ProvenanceCheck INFO suggestion, not a schema error.

PageDoc.description: Page-level documentation (ADR-0045 §4). description/intent are exposed (rendered as sanitized inline markdown in the docs drawer); assumptions/notes carry research-audience detail. Manifest/page scope, never on elements.

description.description: Exposed/human: what this page shows. Rendered as sanitized inline markdown.

intent.description: Exposed/human: why this page exists / the decision it supports. Rendered as sanitized inline markdown.

assumptions.description: Assumptions behind this page's analysis. Reuses ProvenanceClaim (ADR-0045 §4).

notes.description: Research-audience caveats / data-quality notes. Rendered text-escaped (not markdown) per ADR-0045 §5.

ProvenanceClaim.description: A provenance-bearing assumption or conclusion (DVT-249, ADR-0004 Amendment 1). Records WHAT was claimed and WHO claimed it, so a reader (human or agent) can distinguish an agent's unverified assertion from a human-confirmed one.

text.description: The claim body; one sentence preferred.

assertedBy.description: Who asserted this claim. AUTHOR-ASSERTED, not server-attested — until DVT-267 reconciles this against the authenticated request actor, a consumer must not treat assertedBy:human as proof a human confirmed it.

validatedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC time a human confirmed this claim. Absent = unvalidated; an agent-asserted, unvalidated claim is a known epistemic gap (a ProvenanceCheck INFO), not an error.

PanelProvenance.description: Per-panel documentation at manifest scope (DVT-249), keyed by panel id under meta.panels. Lives here, NOT on the Panel/element schema, because elements are independently versioned and reused across dashboards (ADR-0021) — element-scoped docs would reflect whichever dashboard last wrote them.

purpose.description: Why this panel exists in the dashboard's analytical story.

serves_question.description: Zero-based index into meta.keyQuestions identifying which question this panel answers. An out-of-range index is a ProvenanceCheck WARN. Omit for a panel that serves no single question (navigation/decoration).

documentationStale.description: Server-set (DVT-267): true when THIS panel had a material data change since its provenance was last confirmed, so a multi-panel dashboard can pinpoint which panel's docs rotted. The dashboard-level meta.documentationStale is true when any panel is stale.

intent.description: Agent-facing (not rendered): why this element exists / what decision it informs. Research-audience documentation per ADR-0045 §5.

assumptions.description: Agent-facing (not rendered): assumptions this element's metric makes (joins, filters, grain, data caveats). Reuses ProvenanceClaim (ADR-0045 §5).

notes.description: Agent-facing (not rendered): caveats / data-quality notes for this element. ADR-0045 §5.

preset.description: Named theme preset (ADR-0043, DVT-420). Inserts a pre-baked token tier BETWEEN the org baseline and the dashboard's own tokens (lowest-to-highest: BUILTIN_DEFAULTS → org baseline → PRESET → primitive → semantic → component → theme.overrides → page.theme.preset → page.theme.overrides → panel/element overrides). Off-list values are rejected at schema validation. Fail-closed at resolve time: an unknown name seeds an empty tier. The dashboard's own tokens always win per-key.

primitive.description: Raw values: hex colors, font stacks, spacing numbers as strings. Gated by ThemeTokenMap (DVT-294): color keys are default-deny ColorTokenValue, `.family`/`fontFamily` keys are the closed font-stack enum, dimensional/typographic keys stay loose.

semantic.description: Semantic aliases referencing primitives, e.g. "chart.series.1": "{color.brand-blue}". Gated by ThemeTokenMap (DVT-294).

component.description: Per-component overrides, e.g. "gauge.needle.color": "{chart.series.1}". Gated by ThemeTokenMap (DVT-294).

overrides.description: Dashboard-scoped explicit override tier (DVT-1006, ADR-0014 Amendment 4). Key presence = explicit intent: a key here field-wise FORCES over authored ECharts detail (series itemStyle.color, root color, textStyle.color/fontSize), the same way panel.overrides forces at panel scope — ambient tokens.* never do. Sits ABOVE tokens.component and BELOW panel.overrides (panel wins per key). Gated by ThemeTokenMap (DVT-294).

i.description: Panel id. Must match a panel in panels[].

mode.description: Layout mode (ADR-0027). "grid" (default; absent ⇒ grid) is the standard skin: the 24-col react-grid-layout — columns/rowHeight/breakpoints/items apply. "canvas" is the immersive full-bleed mode: sections[] applies and the grid fields are unused. dvt Core (renderer-neutral). "htmlSlots" is the author-written HTML page mode (ADR-0059): html applies, the grid and canvas fields are unused. dvt Full only — never Core.

fullBleed.description: Render hint (ADR-0027) with per-surface semantics (DVT-2374, slice 1C): this page is designed edge-to-edge. On the immersive `/present` viewer, fullBleed is honored in full — app chrome (nav/tab-bar/drawer) is hidden, padding drops to 0, and content is unconstrained. The standard `/dashboard` viewer and the headless render/export surface honor fullBleed too, but ONLY as padding=0 + maxWidth=none — app chrome is NOT hidden there; only `/present` hides chrome (hiding nav in the main viewer would break navigation). Canvas mode implies full-bleed on `/present` and in the builder preview pane (which mirrors it, DVT-2374 review r2 F3); the standard viewer and the headless render surface still require an explicit `fullBleed: true` — a canvas page without it keeps its padded/capped rendering on those two surfaces. Grid dashboards may also opt in for a kiosk view. dvt Core.

rowHeight.description: Grid row height in px, for the PAGE grid. Default codifies the page-grid renderer's actual fallback (30) — the historical schema default of 40 was drift, never what shipped there. A container element's per-tab sub-grid is a separate renderer path with its own fallback/seed of 40 (ContainerPanel.tsx, container-edit.ts) — unrelated to this default and out of scope for this slice.

gap.description: Inter-tile gutter, in px, between grid items (Lane-1 page rhythm). Effective default today is page-grid 16×16 (stacked-mobile 12); a container element's per-tab sub-grid defaults to 12×12 separately and is unaffected. Honored by the renderer since 1B: an explicit gap (or the ambient `grid.xGap`/`grid.yGap` theme token) applies at ALL widths — no separate mobile knob; the 16/12 default is the only tier that still varies by stacked/desktop. Page-scope only — ignored in a container element's per-tab layout.

padding.description: Outer page padding, in px (Lane-1 page rhythm). An integer applies uniformly to all four sides; the object form sets sides independently (a missing side falls back to the renderer's built-in default for that surface, not to 0). Honored by the renderer since 1B, along with the ambient `page.padding` theme token (a single CSS length applied to all sides) as the next-lowest tier. An explicit padding (spec or the `page.padding` token) applies at ALL widths — it overrides the responsive mobile padding; there is no separate mobile knob. Page-scope only — ignored in a container element's per-tab layout.

maxWidth.description: Page content column max width in px, or "none" for unconstrained. Lane-1 page rhythm. Honored on ALL surfaces since 1B, along with the ambient `page.content.width` theme token as the next-lowest tier; defaults are viewer 1600px, present/render unconstrained, and the spec builder's preview 1400px. Page-scope only — ignored in a container element's per-tab layout.

align.description: Page content horizontal alignment (Lane-1 page rhythm). The enum form is a named preset; the object form is the source of truth underneath and additionally supports a precise offset (doctrine: every enum shorthand has a numeric sibling). `preset` and `x` are mutually exclusive — `x` is a raw position (percentage or px string, or a bare number meaning px) that overrides the preset entirely; a string `x` is clamped at render time to ±100%/±10000px (the numeric branch is already schema-bounded). An object with neither `preset` nor `x` (including `{}` and an offset-only object) is valid: alignment falls back to the default ('center') and `offset` nudges from there. `offset` is applied as a CSS translate; it takes effect even when there is no width constraint to align within. Honored by the renderer since 1B. Page-scope only — ignored in a container element's per-tab layout.

oneOf.description: Exactly one of these closed shapes: `preset`-driven, `x`-driven, or neither (offset-only / empty) — each branch declares only the keys it accepts, so mixing `preset` and `x` fails as an unrecognized property on every branch (an actionable error) rather than an opaque XOR failure.

x.description: Raw horizontal position: a percentage or px string (e.g. "30%", "120px"), or a bare integer meaning px (-10000..10000).

items.description: Per-breakpoint grid item positions. At minimum 'lg' should be present.

sections.description: Canvas-mode sections, in scroll order (ADR-0027). Each section is a fixed design-space rectangle scaled to the viewport; the page scrolls between sections. Used when mode="canvas".

html.description: htmlSlots-mode page template (ADR-0059): author-written HTML sanitized through the DOMPurify gate at render time. Live panels mount where <dvt-slot ref="panelId"></dvt-slot> markers appear; the markers in this HTML are the single source of truth for slot placement — there is no declared slot manifest. ref must match the selector-safe id pattern ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$ (ADR-0030); whether a ref resolves to a real panel id is a render/assembly-time concern, not a schema gate (dangling ref renders empty, duplicate ref mounts twice). Required when mode="htmlSlots". dvt Full (escape hatch), never Core.

AlignOffset.description: Fine-grained pixel nudge applied on top of `preset` or `x` (or on top of the default alignment when both are absent). `y` nudges the content column vertically.

Section.description: A canvas-mode section (ADR-0027): a fixed design-space rectangle the renderer scales to fit the viewport (slide model). Free-form layered blocks live WITHIN a section; scroll-driven narrative lives BETWEEN stacked sections. dvt Core, except an arbitrary-CSS background is an escape hatch (ADR-0014).

id.description: Stable section ID, unique within the layout.

title.description: Optional section label (outline/section nav). Not necessarily rendered.

background.description: Per-section canvas background — any CSS background value (solid, gradient, image), reusing Page.background semantics. A plain color/token is dvt Core; gradients/images/filters are the Full escape hatch (ADR-0014). Falls back to the page.background token.

width.description: Design-space width in design units. Blocks are positioned in these units; the renderer scales the section to the viewport width (aspect-preserving).

height.description: Design-space height in design units (the section's intrinsic canvas).

scroll.description: RESERVED for Phase 2 (DVT-160). Scroll-driven behavior as the section enters the viewport: none (normal flow), pin (sticky while its blocks step), reveal (reveal-on-scroll). Declarative — renderer semantics land in Phase 2; reserved here to avoid a breaking schema change.

blocks.description: Free-form positioned blocks in this section. Each references a panel in panels[] (ADR-0027 — one content model).

CanvasBlock.description: Canvas placement of a panel (ADR-0027). A block says WHERE and in WHAT LAYER a panel sits; the referenced panel says WHAT it is — content stays in panels[], coordinates stay out of the panel body (mirrors the grid items[].i ↔ panel id link, ADR-0021). dvt Core (renderer-neutral).

ref.description: Panel id. Must match a panel in panels[] (or the enclosing page's panels[]). Cross-ref integrity is a render/assembly-time concern, not schema-enforced — same as grid items[].i.

x.description: Left position, in the section's design-space units.

y.description: Top position, in the section's design-space units.

w.description: Width, in the section's design-space units.

h.description: Height, in the section's design-space units.

z.description: Stacking order for layering/overlap. Higher renders on top.

Motion.description: RESERVED for Phase 2 (DVT-160). Declarative entrance/transition for a block — compiled at render time like a FormatObject, NEVER a function in the spec (ADR-0016). The renderer must honor prefers-reduced-motion. Reserved here to avoid a breaking schema change.

type.description: Animation kind. count-up is for numeric/KPI blocks.

delay.description: Delay before the animation starts, in milliseconds.

type.description: Compiled to an ECharts formatter function at render time. No functions in the spec.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Required when type=currency.

pattern.description: Date format pattern (type=date) or a d3-format pattern string (type=custom), e.g. ',.2f', '$,.0f', '.1%', '~s'.

prefix.description: Arbitrary string prepended to the formatted value.

suffix.description: Arbitrary string appended to the formatted value.

locale.description: BCP-47 locale for separators; defaults to en-US for deterministic output.

unit.description: Input time unit for type=duration. Default 'ms'.

negativeParens.description: Accounting-style parentheses for negative values, e.g. (1,234) instead of -1,234. Default false. Applied after all other formatting. DVT-513.

scaleBy.description: Divide the raw value by this factor before formatting, e.g. 1000 to display thousands. Distinct from compact notation — use when the unit label (prefix/suffix) reflects the scaling (e.g. suffix:' K'). DVT-513.

PanelData.description: Data binding for a panel. Use query for direct SQL (demo). metricRef preferred once the semantic layer is built.

sourceId.description: Reference to a configured data source: EITHER the connection NAME (matches data_sources.name, the human alias) OR the connection UUID. Both resolve at query time (a literal name match wins if a name ever collides with another connection's UUID) — see docs/02-spec/connection-as-code.md. The stored/applied form is typically the UUID (a name is resolved to its UUID at apply time). In snowflake native mode (DVT_MODE=snowflake) the boot-provisioned caller's-rights source is named 'Host Snowflake'; set sourceId to that name (or its UUID) for the panel's query to run against the caller's own Snowflake account.

query.description: Direct SQL query. Pushdown to the analytics engine. MUST be executable SQL, never a natural-language description — the query inspector shows this string verbatim and the engine executes it verbatim (advisory lint `query-sql`, DVT-1242). For baked/derived data, keep the real producing SQL here alongside `rows`; document non-SQL derivation steps as trailing `--` comments.

rows.description: Baked result rows. When present the panel renders from these directly and skips the live query — the backend-free path that lets a spec render statically (demo, /builder). Keep `query` alongside so the SQL inspector stays honest.

metricRef.description: Named metric from the semantic layer (preferred over direct query).

params.description: Parameterized query bindings. A list-valued binding is an array (multi-select) param expanded to an IN-list of per-index placeholders (DVT-170); the engine reserves the `__<int>` key suffix for those synthetic per-index keys, so author keys may not end in it.

PanelType.description: Supported element types. chart:* render via ECharts (the dvt→ECharts series mapping lives in spec/schema/echarts/chart-types.json, ADR-0022); metric-strip/kpi/text/html/table are dvt-native. kpi (DVT-133) is a grid single-value scorecard — a headline number with an explicit period-over-period comparison binding and an optional inline sparkline (the grid sibling of the canvas `stat` block; both share the count-up + delta primitives). hero/stat/media/divider are the rich canvas blocks (DVT-161, ADR-0027): hero (headline), stat (single big number, shares the metric-strip count-up primitive), media (image — src sanitized, ADR-0027 §2), divider (rule line); metric-strip/kpi/hero/stat/divider/section are dvt Core (renderer-neutral), media is the ADR-0014 escape hatch. section (DVT-469) is a grid heading band: the panel title is the heading, plus an optional one-line subtitle and a hairline rule — spans full width (w:24 by convention) and takes no query. filter (DVT-140, ADR-0028) is a dvt-native, dvt Core query-bound control whose selected value re-queries its target panels by name. filter-bar (DVT-551) is a dvt-native, dvt Core layout primitive that groups several filter elements into one horizontal band. Advanced types: chart:map requires a registered GeoJSON map asset (USA bundled, ADR-0023); chart:custom requires a registered $dvtRef renderItem (ADR-0016); chart:calendar (DVT-2111) renders daily values on a real calendar grid — an ECharts `calendar` coordinate system paired with a `heatmap` series — with the visible date range derived from the data rather than declared. chart:waterfall (DVT-2110) renders a bridge from a starting value to an ending value via a sequence of deltas: two `bar` series sharing one `stack` (an invisible spacer plus the visible bar) binding the existing Core `categoryField`/`valueField` keys — a row whose `valueField` is SQL NULL is a subtotal/total bar convention (drawn from 0 to the running total, which the row does not itself change), not a separate schema key. Animated/temporal types (DVT-275, ADR-0034): chart:bar:racing + chart:line:racing (continuous-tween races) and chart:geo:animated (timeline choropleth) require an `animation` block (frameField); they are dvt Full / non-portable and render to a static poster frame in exports (ADR-0024).

valueField.description: Data row field name to display.

agg.description: How to reduce a multi-row column to the headline number. Default: sum.

description.description: Optional plain-text explanation of what this metric is and how it's calculated; shown as a hover tooltip.

changeField.description: Optional field for % change vs prior period.

sparklines.description: Per-tile override of the strip-wide `sparklines` default. Unset inherits the strip setting; `false` hides this tile's sparkline even when the strip shows them (e.g. a non-additive metric with no honest trend).

delta.description: Per-tile override of the strip-wide `delta` default. Unset inherits the strip setting; `false`/`true` win for this tile.

CellPredicate.description: A predicate that tests a row/cell value. Either a leaf node (op) or a combinator (all/any). Nesting depth capped at 5 by the spec-size lint. Tier-B operators (topN, bottomN) are cap-sensitive — see ADR-0044 §2.

field.description: Column to test. Defaults to the column the rule is attached to. Required for table-wide rules.

op.description: Comparison operator. eq/neq/gt/gte/lt/lte/between/contains/isNull/isNotNull are Tier-A (cap-tolerant). topN/bottomN are Tier-B (cap-sensitive — a degraded badge appears when the result was truncated).

value.description: Comparison value. Scalar literal or { field } cross-column reference for single-value ops. For 'between': [lo, hi]. For 'in'/'notIn': array of scalars. For 'topN'/'bottomN': integer N. Omitted for isNull/isNotNull.

all.description: AND-combine a list of sub-predicates (mutually exclusive with 'op' at this node).

any.description: OR-combine a list of sub-predicates (mutually exclusive with 'op' at this node).

CellStyle.description: The style applied to a cell or row when a predicate matches. Color slots accept either a ColorTokenValue literal/token (gated by schema pattern at author-time) or a FieldColorRef {fromField} (warehouse-controlled, gated by sanitizeBackground at render time — ADR-0044 §7, DVT-510). String vs object is disjoint so the oneOf is safe with no overlap.

fill.description: Background fill color: a ColorTokenValue literal/token (hex/rgb/named/{token}) or {fromField:"col"} to read from a bound row column. When set and textColor is omitted, the renderer auto-picks a legible text color via the WCAG contrast helper (ADR-0044 §5). Field-sourced values are sanitized at render time by sanitizeBackground.

textColor.description: Text color: a ColorTokenValue literal/token or {fromField:"col"} to read from a bound row column. Explicit value always wins over auto-contrast. Field-sourced values are sanitized at render time by sanitizeBackground.

align.description: Text alignment override for this cell.

ConditionalFormatRule.description: One conditional-format rule: a predicate selects a row/cell; a style is applied when it matches. Multiple rules compose last-wins per style key (first-wins when stopIfMatched is true). ADR-0044 §3.

where.description: The predicate that must evaluate to true for the style to apply.

apply.description: The style to apply when the predicate matches.

target.description: What the style paints when the predicate matches: 'cell' (default) = the tested cell; 'row' = the whole row; any other string = that column's cell in the same row. (ADR-0044 §3)

stopIfMatched.description: When true, later rules in the same array do not apply once this rule matches (first-wins). Default false = later rules layer over earlier (last-wins per style key).

ColorScale.description: Continuous background color scale for a table column — a heatmap that paints a tint proportional to the cell's numeric value. Computed client-side over the column's bound rows (ADR-0011). domain:'auto' and method:'quantile' are Tier-B cap-sensitive (ADR-0044 §2). ADR-0044 §3.

method.description: How the column's values map to color stops. 'numeric' = linear interpolation between domain bounds; 'bin' = equal-width bins; 'quantile' = nearest-rank percentile bins (Tier-B cap-sensitive).

domain.description: The [min, (mid,) max] value bounds, or 'auto' (default) to derive from the column's finite values. 'auto' and quantile method are Tier-B cap-sensitive when the result is truncated.

palette.description: Named ramp from the color-schemes registry (e.g. 'blues', 'rdbu', 'viridis') or an explicit array of ColorTokenValue stops (at least 2). Defaults to 'blues'.

oneOf.description: A named color scheme from the registry (viridis, magma, blues, rdbu, brbg, spectral, okabe-ito, set2).
Explicit array of color stops (at least 2, each a ColorTokenValue).

bins.description: Number of equal-width bins for method:'bin'. Defaults to 5.

nullColor.description: Background color for null/NaN cells. When omitted, null cells receive no background (transparent).

ColumnGroup.description: A spanning column-group header rendered above the normal column-header row (gt tab_spanner). dvt Core (DVT-514).

label.description: Text shown in the spanning header cell.

columns.description: Field names of the leaf columns this group spans. Mutually exclusive with nested columnGroups (use one or the other). Columns in a group should be CONTIGUOUS in the rendered column order; a group whose columns are separated by an ungrouped column renders its spanner label once per contiguous run.

columnGroups.description: Nested sub-groups. When set, the spanner spans all leaf columns of its descendants. Mutually exclusive with columns.

field.description: Data row field name for this column.

label.description: Header label; defaults to the field name. Overrides any warehouse COMMENT resolved via TableSpec.metadataSource.

description.description: Column description shown in an info (ⓘ) tooltip on the header. Overrides any warehouse COMMENT resolved via TableSpec.metadataSource.

headerSource.description: Where the header label comes from when no manual `label` is set. 'manual' (default) keeps the field name; 'warehouse_comment' lets a COMMENT resolved via TableSpec.metadataSource fill the label.

align.description: Cell alignment; defaults to right for numeric values, left otherwise.

sortable.description: Whether the column header offers click-to-sort (asc/desc/none). Defaults to true.

filterable.description: Whether the column offers a view-time filter control (text contains / numeric range). Defaults to true.

conditionalFormat.description: Column-level conditional-format rules. Applied after table-wide rules (more specific). Rules compose last-wins per style key unless stopIfMatched:true. ADR-0044 §3.

colorScale.description: Continuous heatmap for this column: paints a background tint proportional to each cell's numeric value, keeping the value text visible (auto-contrast §5). ADR-0044 §3.

cell.description: In-cell visualization that replaces the plain text value (DVT-511, ADR-0044 §4). Dispatched by kind to an inline SVG producer in cell-viz/. Client-side only over already-bound rows (ADR-0011). Unimplemented kinds fall back to plain text.

textStyle.description: Per-column base text style for data cells (DVT-513, ADR-0044 §3b). Applied as the column base before colorScale and conditionalFormat overrides (lowest precedence of the three). font is the closed FontFamilyTokenValue enum; color is ColorTokenValue-gated.

width.description: Fixed column width in px (40–1200). Omitted = auto-sized by content. When any column sets a width the table switches to a fixed layout. Editable via the tray or by dragging the column border; AI authors the same field (ADR-0044 §3c).

wrap.description: Allow multi-line text wrapping for data cells in this column. Default false → single-line (cells never wrap; long values widen the column or, with a width set, clip to an ellipsis). Enable for text columns whose values commonly exceed ~30 characters (ADR-0044 §3c).

maxLines.description: Only meaningful with wrap:true. Clamp wrapped cell text to at most this many lines and show an explicit 'See more' / 'Show less' toggle when the value overflows. Omitted = wrap with no clamp (ADR-0044 §3c).

ColumnTextStyle.description: Per-column base text style for data cells (DVT-513, ADR-0044 §3b). Every color slot is ColorTokenValue; font is the closed FontFamilyTokenValue enum (no free text). Applied UNDER colorScale and conditionalFormat rules — those override it per style key.

weight.description: Font weight for data cells in this column.

align.description: Text alignment for data cells. Overrides the column's default alignment (right for numeric, left otherwise).

size.description: Font size in pixels (8–48). Applied to data cells only (not the header).

font.description: Font family for data cells. Closed enum (ADR-0032 §A3, DVT-294) — no free-text CSS.

color.description: Text color for data cells. Gated by ColorTokenValue (hex/rgb/named/{token}).

transform.description: CSS text-transform applied to data cells.

decoration.description: CSS text-decoration applied to data cells.

ValueSeriesSource.description: How a multi-value series reaches one cell (DVT-511, ADR-0044 §4). Exactly one of valuesField or valuesFromColumns must be set.

valuesField.description: Column whose cell value holds a delimited string (comma-separated) or JSON array of numbers.

valuesFromColumns.description: Ordered list of sibling column names whose values form the series for this row.

TableCell.description: In-cell visualization replacing the plain text value (DVT-511/512, ADR-0044 §4). Discriminated by kind. Implemented: sparkline, bar, bullet, winloss, dot (DVT-511), icon, image (DVT-512). Others (text, heatmap, markdown) are forward-compat enum members that fall back to plain text until their child tickets land.

TableCellText.description: Explicit text kind (no-op, default rendering). Useful for authoring clarity.

TableCellSparkline.description: Mini inline trend line/area/bar chart per row (DVT-511). Rendered as inline SVG.

source.description: How to resolve the numeric series for this row.

min.description: Fixed domain minimum; defaults to the series min.

max.description: Fixed domain maximum; defaults to the series max.

TableCellBar.description: Horizontal data bar sized to the cell value (DVT-511). Inline SVG. Diverges at baseline for negative values.

domain.description: Numeric domain [min, max] or 'auto' to compute from the column's bound values.

color.description: Bar fill color. Gated by ColorTokenValue.

negativeColor.description: Fill color for bars below baseline. Gated by ColorTokenValue.

hideNumber.description: When true, suppress the inline text value. Default false.

baseline.description: Value at which the bar diverges. Default 0.

TableCellBullet.description: Bullet chart per cell: a value bar + target reference line + optional qualitative bands (DVT-511). Inline SVG.

valueField.description: Column supplying the measured value. Defaults to this column's own value.

targetField.description: Column supplying the target value per row (takes precedence over target).

qualBands.description: Ordered qualitative band thresholds (e.g. [50, 80] splits the domain into poor/ok/good).

TableCellWinLoss.description: Win/loss tile strip per row (DVT-511). Inline SVG. Positive = win, negative = loss, zero = tie.

source.description: How to resolve the numeric series for this row.

winColor.description: Tile color for positive values. Gated by ColorTokenValue.

lossColor.description: Tile color for negative values. Gated by ColorTokenValue.

tieColor.description: Tile color for zero values. Gated by ColorTokenValue.

TableCellDot.description: Positioned dot marker on a domain scale (DVT-511). Inline SVG.

color.description: Dot fill color. Gated by ColorTokenValue.

TableCellHeatmap.description: Heatmap cell background (DVT-509, forward-compat stub — falls back to text until DVT-509 lands).

CellIconRef.description: Allow-listed icon name (ADR-0044 §7). Must match exactly one entry in the bundled icon-registry. An unknown name renders nothing — never injected into markup. The set of valid names is the union of the Font Awesome curated set + country flag codes defined in web/src/components/cell-viz/icon-registry.ts. A set-equality test enforces that this enum and the registry stay in sync.

TableCellIcon.description: Allow-listed icon cell (DVT-512, ADR-0044 §7). Renders a bundled SVG icon by name. name/nameField selects the icon; a name not in the CellIconRef allow-list renders nothing. color/colorField tints the icon (ColorTokenValue literal or sanitized field value). Inline SVG via JSX — no raw value injected into markup.

name.description: Static icon name from the allow-listed set. Takes precedence over nameField when both are set.

nameField.description: Column field whose value selects the icon at render time. Checked against CellIconRef allow-list; a miss renders nothing.

color.description: Static icon tint color. Gated by ColorTokenValue schema pattern.

colorField.description: Column field whose value is the icon tint color at render time. Gated at render time by sanitizeBackground (css-safety.ts). Takes precedence over color when both are set.

TableCellImage.description: Logo/avatar/thumbnail image cell (DVT-512, ADR-0044 §7). src/srcField must pass sanitizeMediaSrc + ALLOWED_MEDIA_HOSTS (allowed: same-origin relative, https on assets.dvt.dev/dvt.dev, raster data: URIs; SVG excluded). A blocked src renders a placeholder — never a live fetch to an unapproved host.

src.description: Static image URL or data URI. Gated at render time by sanitizeMediaSrc. Only https on allowed dvt asset hosts, same-origin relative paths, and raster data: URIs are permitted.

srcField.description: Column field whose value is the image URL at render time. Same sanitizeMediaSrc gate as src — warehouse-controlled values are not looser than authored literals.

shape.description: Display shape. 'circle' applies border-radius:50% for avatars. Default 'rect'.

height.description: Image height in pixels. Width scales proportionally. Default 32.

altField.description: Column field whose value is the alt text at render time. Rendered as a React string — auto-escaped by JSX.

TableCellMarkdown.description: Markdown cell (DVT-513, ADR-0044 §4 + §7). Renders the cell's string value as sanitized markdown → DOMPurify with an explicit ALLOWED_TAGS/ALLOWED_URI_REGEXP allowlist. The value comes from the bound row; no {{ variable }} interpolation. No img tag; only https/mailto URIs permitted.

mode.description: Markdown grammar. 'inline' (default, backward-compatible) renders bold/italic/links/code only via marked.parseInline — single logical line. 'block' renders full GFM block markdown (lists, headings, paragraphs, blockquote) via marked.parse for multi-line rich cells. Both pass the same DOMPurify allowlist (ADR-0044 §7).

TableSort.description: A table sort key: a column field and a direction. Applied client-side over the fetched rows; the user can change it ephemerally at view time.

ChartSpec.description: Spec for chart:* elements — near-passthrough to the ECharts option. Token refs resolved at render time. No functions — use format objects and $dvtRef instead. dvt-native element fields (metrics, markdown, variant, align, html, columns) are not allowed on charts.

xAxis.description: X-axis configuration. A single AxisSpec object, or an array of AxisSpec objects for multi-axis charts. additionalProperties:true on AxisSpec keeps the full ECharts xAxis passthrough (any raw ECharts key validates). Use the documented AxisSpec properties (type/min/max/scale/name/nameLocation/axisLabel/…) for dvt Core authoring.

yAxis.description: Y-axis configuration. A single AxisSpec object, or an array of AxisSpec objects for dual-axis charts (secondary axis: yAxis:[{},{position:'right'}] + series[].yAxisIndex:1). additionalProperties:true on AxisSpec keeps the full ECharts yAxis passthrough. The lint warns when series[].yAxisIndex > 0 but yAxis is not an array of sufficient length.

dataField.description: Data row field name to bind to this series.

legend.description: Chart legend. dvt Core sub-keys (`show`, `position`, `values`) are renderer-neutral and consumed + stripped by the compiler; any OTHER key here is the ECharts legend passthrough (the escape hatch). Multi-series cartesian charts (and funnels) auto-get a legend when none is present; single-series cartesian charts do not (pie/donut legends are author-set). Raw ECharts placement keys (`top`/`left`/`right`/`bottom`/`orient`) set directly on `legend` win over the `position` shorthand.

show.description: Show or hide the legend. `false` suppresses auto-injection even on multi-series charts.

position.description: dvt Core placement shorthand. `top`/`bottom` render a horizontal legend; `left`/`right` render a vertical legend (orient:vertical). Compiled to ECharts placement keys and stripped — not a native ECharts key. Raw ECharts placement keys on the legend object win over this shorthand.

values.description: Value-in-legend: appends an aggregated series value to each legend label. Compiled to a `legend.formatter` closure over the bound data — no JS in the spec. dvt Core (multi-series cartesian families). Stripped before the compiled option is emitted.

agg.description: `last` = last non-null value; `total` = sum; `min`/`max`/`mean` as named.

tooltip.description: Chart hover tooltip. dvt Core sub-keys: `fields` (extra columns on hover), `total` (shared-axis sum row), `order` (row sort order), `template` (function-free per-series row template), `crosshair` (axis pointer style). Any OTHER key here is the ECharts tooltip passthrough (the escape hatch). Tooltip enrichment is supported on the row-indexed chart families — bar/line/area, pie/donut, scatter — and is ignored on pivot/aggregating families.

fields.description: Extra query-result columns to show on hover, in addition to the encoded series values. Each entry binds one column by name; absent columns are skipped. Portable (dvt Core).

field.description: Query-result column name to display (resolved case-tolerantly against the actual result columns).

label.description: Display label for this row. Defaults to a humanized form of the field name.

total.description: Shared-axis tooltip: append a row summing the series values at the hovered category. dvt Core.

show.description: When true, renders a total row summing all numeric series values at the hovered category.

label.description: Display label for the total row. Defaults to "Total".

order.description: Sort order for per-series rows in the tooltip. `asc`/`desc` sort by numeric series value; `seriesIndex` keeps the original series order (default). dvt Core.

template.description:
Function-free per-series row template. Tokens: `{value}` → formatted series value, `{label}` → series name, `{field:<name>}` → a named query-result column from the hovered row. Token grammar: only `{value}`, `{label}`, and `{field:[A-Za-z0-9_]+}` are substituted; everything else is treated as a literal (unknown tokens are left as-is). All substituted values and all literal template text are HTML-escaped — no eval, no function construction. dvt Core; functions are never allowed in specs.

Example: `"{label}: {value} ({field:region})"`

crosshair.description: Axis pointer (crosshair) style — compiles to ECharts `tooltip.axisPointer`. dvt Core.

axis.description: `x` or `y` → a line pointer on that axis; `both` → cross pointer on both axes.

label.description: When true, shows the axis value label on the pointer line.

snap.description: When true, the pointer snaps to the nearest data point.

funnelRate.description: Funnel conversion-rate display (chart:funnel). dvt Core (portable): the renderer computes step/overall/total conversion % from the bound stage values and shows them in the funnel labels — no hand-written ECharts formatter needed. Stages are read in data (row) order. A raw series[].label.formatter remains the Full escape hatch and takes precedence over this.

mode.description: step = % of the previous stage (first stage = 100%); overall = % of the first stage; total = % of the sum of all stages; none = raw value only (no rate).

showValue.description: Also show the formatted raw stage value alongside the rate (uses the panel's valueFormat if present, else a grouped number).

precision.description: Decimal places on the rate percentage.

label.description: Value/data labels on marks (bar/line/area, pie/donut, scatter). dvt Core (portable): the renderer puts the formatted datum value on each mark — no hand-written ECharts label.formatter needed. A raw series[].label.formatter remains the Full escape hatch and takes precedence. Ignored on pivot/relational families (stacked bar, heatmap, funnel, sankey, etc.). Per-family default: cartesian families (bar/line/area/scatter) are default-OFF — labels paint only with an explicit `show:true`. Pie/donut are default-ON — they inherit ECharts' slice labels, so labels paint unless `show:false`; an absent `show` (with any other label control set) still routes through the dvt label pipeline, and the value label is prefixed with the slice name (`"2019: 42.0%"`) since a pie has no axis to carry that identity (DVT-1128).

show.description: Show value labels on marks. The `default:false` is the cartesian-family (bar/line/area/scatter) contract — those paint labels only with an explicit `show:true`. Pie/donut are default-ON (they inherit ECharts' slice labels): there an absent `show` renders the labels and only `show:false` suppresses them (DVT-1128).

position.description: Label position; per chart type — bar→top/inside, horizontal bar→right, line/area→top, pie/donut→outside/inside, scatter→top. Defaults sensibly per type when omitted. On pie/donut the default is `outside` (leader-line labels, name-prefixed `name: value`), but switches to `inside` (value only, prefix dropped) when a legend is shown on the left/right — outside labels and a side legend share the same horizontal band and would collide (DVT-1130). A top/bottom legend or no legend keeps `outside`; an explicit position always wins.

derive.description: Show a computed display metric instead of the raw value (DVT-306): percentOfTotal = datum as % of the series sum; deltaPrev / deltaPrevPct = absolute / percent change vs the previous datum (signed ▲/▼, '—' at the first point). Computed declaratively from the bound series data; formatted via `format`. dvt Core.

rotate.description: Label rotation in degrees (DVT-997). Positive rotates clockwise. dvt Core.

fontSize.description: Label font size in pixels (DVT-997). dvt Core.

color.description: Label text color — a CSS color string or a `{token}` reference resolved before compilation (DVT-997). Gated through the same SSRF-safe color guard as `categoryColors`/`colorRules`; an unsafe value (e.g. `image://`, `url(...)`) is dropped and the authored/default label color is left untouched. dvt Core.

gridlines.description: Declarative gridline control (dvt Core). Compiles to per-axis ECharts splitLine. A raw axis.splitLine set directly on xAxis/yAxis wins over this.

banding.description: Zebra-stripe banding on an axis (dvt Core). Compiles to ECharts splitArea on the named axis. colors defaults to a faint alternating pair from the chart.grid.zebra.color token when omitted. A raw axis.splitArea wins over this.

axis.description: Which axis carries the alternating bands.

colors.description: Two-element array of CSS colors for the alternating bands. Defaults to [zebraToken, 'transparent'].

plotArea.description: Plot-area background and border (dvt Core). Compiles to ECharts grid.backgroundColor / grid.borderColor / grid.show. A raw option.grid key wins over this.

background.description: Plot area fill color (CSS color string).

border.description: Plot area border color (CSS color string).

gridPadding.description: Plot-area inset overrides (dvt Core). Partial deep-merges over the theme defaults; containLabel always stays true. A raw option.grid key wins over this.

density.description: Preset plot-area spacing (dvt Core). 'compact' tightens the default insets for dense dashboards. A raw option.grid or gridPadding key wins over density.

palette.description: Named categorical color scheme for the series palette (dvt Core). One of the registered F2 scheme names (e.g. 'okabe-ito', 'set2', 'viridis'). Overrides the brand default palette and any chart.series.N token when set. Compiled to option.color; stripped before the option is emitted. A raw passthrough option.color still wins over this.

categoryColors.description: Per-category color map (dvt Core, DVT-970/DVT-995/DVT-971/DVT-1072): keys are category values as returned by the query, or an author-inline series[].data datum's name (both coerced with String()), values are colors. Binds a color to a category IDENTITY — pie/donut slices, funnel stages, (DVT-971) stacked-bar/stacked-percent series (keyed by the seriesField value), and (DVT-1072) sunburst top-level/inner-ring nodes (keyed by node name) — so colors survive row reorder and insertion, unlike a positional array. Chart families outside this set (e.g. treemap/tree/graph, cartesian bar/line/area) silently ignore this key. Compiled to per-datum itemStyle.color (pie/funnel), per-series itemStyle.color (stacked-bar), or per-node itemStyle.color on the top-level/inner-ring nodes plus graduated lighter tints painted onto their descendant arcs so the whole wedge follows the region color (sunburst — DVT-1100; the compiler sets the shades explicitly because ECharts does not propagate an explicit color override to children); stripped before the option is emitted. Unlisted categories fall through to the author-inline datum's own itemStyle.color when set (pie/funnel/sunburst) or the positional seriesColors cycle (stacked-bar), else the palette. Precedence (DVT-995 — explicit Core wins field-wise over authored Full detail): an explicit entry here wins over an author-inline series[].data datum's itemStyle.color for the SAME category; colorRules (conditional exceptions) win over both on query-bound data; on author-inline data colorRules never evaluate (they require query rows), so categoryColors is the final per-datum word there.

additionalProperties.description: Hex, rgb, or a token ref (e.g. '{semantic.negative}'). Token refs are resolved by resolveSpecTokens before the compiler runs. Validated by safeChartColor at compile time.

colorRules.description: Conditional per-datum color (dvt Core). Rules are evaluated at compile time for each bound data row; the first matching rule wins. Applies to row-indexed families (bar, line, area, scatter, pie, donut). Compiled to per-datum itemStyle.color; stripped before the option is emitted. The raw ECharts series[].data passthrough (Full) still wins over this.

op.description: Comparison operator. lt/lte/gt/gte coerce to number; eq matches string or number; in checks membership (value must be an array); between checks inclusive range (value must be [lo, hi]).

value.description: Comparison value. Number or string for scalar ops; array of numbers/strings for 'in'; [lo, hi] pair for 'between'.

color.description: Hex, rgb, or a token ref (e.g. '{semantic.negative}'). Token refs are resolved by resolveSpecTokens before the compiler runs. Validated by safeChartColor at compile time.

colorScale.description: Continuous or stepped value-to-color encoding (dvt Core). Compiles to an ECharts visualMap. Applies to heatmap and scatter (when a value field is present). Stripped before the option is emitted.

type.description: sequential = linear gradient; diverging = bi-directional (use domainMid to set the neutral center); piecewise = stepped buckets.

scheme.description: Name of a registered F2 color scheme (e.g. 'viridis', 'rdbu', 'blues'). Resolved to a hex ramp by colorRamp().

domain.description: [min, max] — overrides the auto-computed data extent for the visualMap scale.

domainMid.description: For diverging scales: the neutral midpoint value (default: midpoint of domain). Ignored for other scale types.

buckets.description: For piecewise scales: number of equal-width buckets to split the domain into. Minimum 2.

annotations.description: Declarative reference lines, bands, and callout markers drawn over cartesian charts (dvt Core, ADR-0041). Translated at compile time into ECharts markLine/markArea/markPoint on the host series; the key is stripped before the option is emitted. Gated to cartesian families (line/area/bar/scatter/combo); ignored on axis-less families (pie/gauge/funnel/sankey). Each item is a closed annotation descriptor.

type.description: Annotation kind. 'line' renders a full-width/height reference rule (markLine); 'band' renders a shaded range (markArea); 'point' renders a single marker at a coordinate (markPoint); 'text' renders a label callout with no symbol (markPoint with symbol:none).

axis.description: Which axis the annotation is measured against. Defaults to 'y' when omitted. 'y' places a horizontal rule/band; 'x' places a vertical rule or event marker.

value.description: Fixed scalar position on the chosen axis (line/point). E.g. 100 for a y=100 reference line. Placement precedence for a value-bearing annotation is stat -> valueField -> value -> at; use one at a time.

valueField.description: Query-bound threshold (dvt Core, ADR-0041 §8 / DVT-419): resolve the annotation's scalar position from a named column of the panel's OWN result rows (the first finite numeric value — a threshold column is expected to carry one repeated/constant value, e.g. a plan or SLA broadcast across rows by a CROSS JOIN). Reads the same already-bound rows the series compiled from — never a second query (ADR-0011 preserved). Case-tolerant column match (exact wins, else case-insensitive); distinct from per-datum series binding. If the column is absent or all-non-numeric at render the annotation is dropped (the server cannot see live query columns). Applies to line/point/text; mutually exclusive with value and stat.

from.description: Start of a band range on the chosen axis (band only). Use with 'to'.

to.description: End of a band range on the chosen axis (band only). Use with 'from'.

at.description: Categorical or time position on the x-axis for event markers — e.g. a date string '2024-06-01' or a category label. Emitted only as a coordinate value (xAxis); never used as an axis key or evaluable expression.

stat.description: Compute the annotation position from result data at compile time — avg (arithmetic mean), median, min, or max. Without `of`, the stat is computed over the host series' bound values (DVT-413). With `of`, it is computed over that named result column (ADR-0041 §8 / DVT-419). Either way the result is emitted as a numeric literal so the spec stays pure data (no ECharts built-in callback). A stat over empty or all-non-numeric data drops the annotation rather than emitting NaN.

of.description: Field the `stat` aggregates over (ADR-0041 §8 / DVT-419). When present, `stat` is computed across this named column of the panel's OWN result rows; when absent, `stat` falls back to the host series' bound values (DVT-413). Case-tolerant column match. Only meaningful together with `stat`.

label.description: Optional text label shown on the annotation (dvt Core, ADR-0041 §9 / DVT-493). Either a plain string (back-compat: just the text) OR a styled object. In both forms the text is emitted ONLY as a static formatter string (never spreads author keys onto the ECharts label object) and truncated to 256 chars; backgroundColor / rich are never emitted (ADR-0041 §4/§5 — those are the image:// SSRF sinks).

text.description: The label text. Emitted as a static formatter string; truncated to 256 chars.

color.description: Label text color. Hex literal or a token ref (resolved before the compiler runs); validated by safeChartColor. When omitted, line/point labels default to the mark's own color and band labels to the annotation.label.color token.

size.description: Label font size in px. Clamped to [1,100]; falls back to the annotation.label.size token (11) when omitted.

bold.description: Render the label in a bold font weight.

italic.description: Render the label in an italic font style.

maxWidth.description: Maximum label width in px. When set, the label wraps (ECharts label width + overflow:'break') instead of running off the plot. Clamped to [1,2000].

position.description: Label placement (dvt Core, ADR-0041 §9 / DVT-500). Mapped per mark type: line annotations honor start/middle/end (along the line, kept inside the grid); point/text/band annotations honor top/bottom/left/right/inside. Values that don't apply to the mark type fall back to the default placement (line: end; point/text: top).

offset.description: Pixel nudge [dx, dy] applied to the label position (dvt Core, DVT-500) — e.g. [0, 12] bumps the label down. Each component clamped to [-1000, 1000].

rotate.description: Label rotation in degrees (dvt Core, DVT-500). Clamped to [-90, 90]. Vertical (x-axis) reference-line labels default to 0 (horizontal) so they read normally instead of running along the line.

style.description: Line style for 'line' annotations. Defaults to 'dashed' (the annotation.line.style token default).

width.description: Line width in px for 'line' annotations. Falls back to the annotation.line.width token (1) when omitted; non-finite/out-of-range values fall back to the token default.

color.description: Annotation color. Hex literal or a token ref (e.g. '{semantic.warning}'). Token refs are resolved before the compiler runs. Validated by safeChartColor at compile time — image://, url(, javascript:, expression( are rejected to the default.

opacity.description: Fill opacity for 'band' annotations. Clamped to [0,1]; non-finite values fall back to the annotation.band.opacity token default (0.12).

footnotes.description: Declarative chart footnotes (DVT-569, ADR-0045 §3; parity with TableSpec.footnotes / ADR-0044 §9). Each footnote's sanitized-markdown text is listed in a notes block beneath the chart. 'where.column' anchors to a series/axis label where resolvable; otherwise the note is listed without a superscript anchor.

sourceNote.description: Source attribution line rendered beneath the chart footnote block (DVT-569, ADR-0045 §3). Sanitized markdown (https/mailto links only; no raw HTML). Shown after any footnotes[].

Animation.description: Playback contract for animated/temporal chart panels — chart:bar:racing, chart:line:racing, chart:geo:animated (DVT-275, ADR-0034). dvt Full / non-portable and declarative-only: NO $dvtRef or _unsafeCallback are permitted here (additionalProperties:false) — the control bar is dvt-owned chrome, not an ECharts escape hatch. The client groups one result set's rows by frameField into ordered frames and iterates in-browser; there is no per-frame query (ADR-0011/0013). Because `animation` is not part of the Core chart surface, any panel carrying it reports conformance `full`.

frameField.description: Column naming the time/sequence dimension the animation steps through. Rows are grouped by this field into ordered frames (bar/line race) or timeline periods (geo).

frames.description: Explicit frame order (stringified frameField values). When omitted, frames are ordered by a numeric/date-aware sort of the distinct frameField values.

speedDefault.description: Initial playback speed multiplier (must be one of `speeds`).

speeds.description: Selectable speed multipliers. A speed scales the playback tick interval AND the ECharts animationDurationUpdate together (kept equal), so the tween stays smooth (ADR-0034 §5).

loop.description: Restart from the first frame after the last instead of stopping. Defaults true (ADR-0034 Amendment 2) so a dashboard panel keeps cycling; set false to play once and park on the final frame. The panel also autoplays on mount (the headless render captures a static poster frame; OS 'prefers-reduced-motion' starts it paused on the first frame, and the viewer can press play).

placement.description: Where the playback control bar renders relative to the chart.

GridlineAxis.description: Per-axis gridline control (dvt Core, DVT-406). Compiles to ECharts splitLine on the corresponding axis. A raw axis.splitLine wins on top.

show.description: Show or hide gridlines on this axis. Default per-axis (value axis shows, category axis hides).

style.description: Gridline dash pattern. Compiles to ECharts lineStyle.type.

color.description: Gridline color (CSS color string). Falls back to chart.grid.line.color token.

AxisSpec.description: Curated, documented axis spec — the dvt Core, renderer-neutral way to set table-stakes axis properties (type/range/log/name/label-rotation/dual-axis). Any axis key NOT listed here is raw ECharts passthrough (the escape hatch, ADR-0014). additionalProperties:true preserves the full ECharts passthrough so existing raw-passthrough specs always validate. Use xAxis/yAxis: [] (array of AxisSpec) for multi-axis/dual-axis charts; series[].yAxisIndex selects the secondary axis.

type.description: Axis scale type. 'value' (default for numeric axes) — continuous numeric; 'category' — discrete labels from data; 'time' — continuous time series; 'log' — logarithmic scale (use logBase to set the base).

min.description: Axis minimum bound. A number fixes the lower bound; the string 'dataMin' derives the minimum from the data. Omit to auto-range.

max.description: Axis maximum bound. A number fixes the upper bound; the string 'dataMax' derives the maximum from the data. Omit to auto-range.

scale.description: Value axis: when true, do not force a zero baseline — the axis range fits the data. Default false (ECharts default).

splitNumber.description: Suggested tick/interval count for a value/time axis. ECharts treats this as a hint — the actual number may differ to produce clean round values. String allows a TokenRef.

logBase.description: Base for a log-scale axis (type: 'log'). Default 10. String allows a TokenRef.

name.description: Axis title label. Rendered near the axis per nameLocation. Styled by chart.axis.name.* tokens.

nameLocation.description: Where along the axis the name label is anchored. 'center' and 'middle' are synonyms. Default 'end'.

nameGap.description: Distance in pixels between the axis name and the axis line. Default 15. String allows a TokenRef (e.g. '{chart.axis.titleGap}').

nameRotate.description: Rotation of the axis name label in degrees. Default 0. String allows a TokenRef.

boundaryGap.description: Category-axis edge padding. Boolean (default true on category axes): when false, the first/last data point sits on the axis edge. Array [startRatio, endRatio] for value axes: fractional padding on each side, e.g. ['10%', '10%'].

inverse.description: Reverse the axis direction (right-to-left for x, top-to-bottom for y). Default false.

position.description: Axis position. Default: 'bottom' for xAxis, 'left' for yAxis. Secondary yAxis is typically 'right'.

axisLabel.description: Axis tick-label formatting and display. Any ECharts axisLabel key is valid here (additionalProperties:true). The documented dvt-Core sub-properties below are the most common; see the ECharts docs for the full surface.

rotate.description: Label rotation in degrees (-90 to 90). Use when long labels overlap. String allows a TokenRef.

interval.description: Label display interval. 0 = every label; 1 = every other; 'auto' = auto-hide overlapping labels. Default 'auto'.

hideOverlap.description: When true, automatically hide overlapping labels. Simpler alternative to setting interval manually.

margin.description: Distance in pixels between label text and the axis line/ticks. String allows a TokenRef.

width.description: Max label width in pixels. Text beyond this width is wrapped or truncated per `overflow`. String allows a TokenRef.

overflow.description: Text overflow handling when a label exceeds `width`. 'truncate' clips with ellipsis; 'break' wraps at word boundaries; 'breakAll' wraps at any character.

format.description: dvt FormatObject that the compiler turns into an ECharts axisLabel.formatter function at render time — the same renderer-neutral format vocabulary used elsewhere (value labels, tooltips, table cells). For date axes this replaces a hand-written formatter pattern. Handled generically by compileFormats.

metrics.description: For metric-strip: ordered list of metric tiles.

layout.description: Tile flow (DVT-292). 'auto' (default): tiles wrap responsively (flex-wrap). 'row': a single non-wrapping row (horizontal scroll on overflow). 'grid': equal-width columns that wrap to fixed rows. dvt Core (renderer-neutral).

sparklines.description: Show the trend sparkline on each tile (DVT-998). Default true (today's behavior). Set false to hide sparklines strip-wide.

delta.description: Show the period-over-period ▲/▼ delta chip on each tile (DVT-998). Default true (today's behavior). Set false to hide the delta chip strip-wide.

valueFontSize.description: Headline value font size in pixels (DVT-998), applied strip-wide. Default 30.

valueColor.description: Headline value color (DVT-998) — a literal hex/named color or a `{token}` reference, applied strip-wide. Default: theme text.primary. A tile's own `MetricItem.color` still wins over this for that tile (matches the existing per-tile-color-wins precedence).

markdown.description: For text panels: markdown body with {{ field | agg | format }} variables resolved against data rows.

HtmlSpec.description: Spec for html elements (sanitized escape hatch).

html.description: For html panels: raw HTML/CSS (sanitized) with {{ field | agg | format }} variables. Escape hatch for heroes, gradients, big-number tiles, custom markup. Exposes --accent/--accent-2/--ink/--muted CSS vars from the theme.

TableSpec.description: Spec for table elements (dvt Core — renderer-neutral).

columns.description: table panels: ordered column definitions. Omitted → every query column, in result order. dvt Core (portable): columns/rows are renderer-neutral semantics, no ECharts involved.

defaultSort.description: Initial sort applied at view time (client-side over the already-fetched rows). The viewer can change or clear it; the change is ephemeral (not persisted to the spec).

metadataSource.description: Opt-in: a fully-qualified relation (database.schema.table) whose warehouse COMMENT metadata supplies column headers/tooltips at view time. Only PASSTHROUGH columns whose name matches a source column (case-insensitive) resolve a comment; aggregate/expression aliases are unaffected and keep their name. Comments are fetched at view time and never persisted (ADR-0011). Manual label/description always win.

grouping.description: Opt-in: collapse the rows into a grouped tree with subtotal/grand-total rows. Computed CLIENT-SIDE over the already-fetched rows (a view transform applied AFTER any sort/filter); never re-bills the warehouse and never rewrites author SQL (ADR-0011). Subtotals are honest over the fetched prefix when the result was capped.

conditionalFormat.description: Table-wide conditional-format rules. Applied before column-level rules (less specific). Can target 'row', 'cell', or a named column. ADR-0044 §3.

columnGroups.description: Spanning column-group headers rendered above the normal column-header row (DVT-514, ADR-0044 §8). Each group labels one or more columns with a shared heading; groups may nest to produce multiple spanner rows. Columns not covered by any group show a blank cell in the spanner row(s). Pure header layout — no data transform.

footnotes.description: Declarative table footnotes (DVT-517, ADR-0044 §9). Each footnote anchors an auto-assigned or explicit mark at a located column header (via 'where') and lists its sanitized-markdown text in a notes block beneath the table. Marks without a resolvable location still appear in the notes block.

sourceNote.description: Source attribution line rendered at the bottom of the footnote block (gt tab_source_note, DVT-517). Sanitized markdown (https/mailto links only; no raw HTML). Shown after any footnotes[].

pivot.description: Pivot/cross-tab mode (DVT-515, ADR-0044 §8). Restructures bound rows client-side into row-dimension columns + value columns generated from the distinct values of the `columns` dimensions. Mutually exclusive with `grouping` (pivot wins; do not combine — no oneOf enforcement to avoid footgun). Inherits the full cell/conditionalFormat/colorScale/format vocabulary on generated value-columns.

PivotSpec.description: Pivot configuration (DVT-515). All restructuring is client-side over bound rows (ADR-0011).

rows.description: Row-dimension fields (the left stub). Order = nesting order.

columns.description: Column-dimension fields whose DISTINCT VALUE TUPLES become generated columns. Expected low-cardinality categoricals — width is capped (see maxColumns).

row.description: Trailing total COLUMN at the right (aggregate across the column-dimension tuples, per row).

column.description: Trailing grand-total ROW at the bottom (aggregate down the rows, per generated column).

maxColumns.description: Cap on generated value-columns (distinct column tuples × values). Default 50. When exceeded, the renderer truncates to the first N (by column-tuple order) and shows a visible 'showing K of J columns (capped)' disclosure — the §2 Tier-B honesty contract.

PivotValue.description: One pivot measure. avg-of-avgs guard (ADR-0044 §8): no `agg` defaults to SUM (never an implicit avg); `avg` must be explicit; `weightField` gives a proper weighted mean Σ(v·w)/Σw.

weightField.description: With agg:'avg', compute a weighted mean over this weight column instead of an unweighted arithmetic mean.

label.description: Display label for this measure (default: field).

format.description: Number format for generated columns of this measure.

colorScale.description: Heat-map color coding applied to every generated column of this measure (ADR-0044 §8 ratification: colorScale MUST be wireable on pivots).

cell.description: In-cell viz for generated columns of this measure.

conditionalFormat.description: CF rules applied to generated columns of this measure.

Footnote.description: One table footnote (DVT-517, ADR-0044 §9). A mark (auto-assigned when omitted) is rendered as a superscript at the located column header; the text appears in a notes block beneath the table. Text is sanitized markdown (marked + DOMPurify, §7 posture: https/mailto only, no raw HTML).

mark.description: Explicit superscript mark (e.g. '*', '†', 'a'). When omitted, sequential marks are auto-assigned in footnotes[] array order (¹ ² ³ …).

where.description: Location of the superscript anchor. Identifies a column header by field name. When omitted (or the field is not found), the footnote has no superscript anchor — it still appears in the notes block.

column.description: Field name of the column whose header should display the superscript mark.

header.description: Alias for 'column' (field name of the target column header). 'column' takes precedence when both are set.

text.description: Footnote text. Sanitized markdown: marked (GFM inline-only) → DOMPurify with ALLOWED_URI_REGEXP ^(https:|mailto:), ALLOW_DATA_ATTR:false, FORBID_TAGS:['style']. No raw HTML reaches the DOM.

TableGrouping.description: Row-grouping config for a table element (DVT-113). Rows are bucketed by groupBy (in order; multiple fields = nested levels), each group rendered as a collapsible header with subtotal/grand-total rows aggregating the measures. Computed client-side over the fetched rows (ADR-0011).

groupBy.description: Ordered group-by column fields (at least one; multiple = nested grouping levels).

aggregations.description: Per-measure rollup for the subtotal/total rows. Columns not listed are blank on those rows.

agg.description: Aggregation for subtotal/total rows. Defaults to sum.

subtotals.description: Show a subtotal row per group. Defaults to true.

grandTotal.description: Show a grand-total row across all groups. Defaults to false.

defaultExpanded.description: Whether groups start expanded. Defaults to true.

totalLabel.description: Label shown in the leading cell of the grand-total row. Defaults to 'Total' when grandTotal is true (DVT-514).

subtotalLabelTemplate.description: Template for the subtotal-row label suffix. Use '{value}' to interpolate the group value. Example: '{value} subtotal'. When omitted the group value alone labels the subtotal header (DVT-514).

HeroSpec.description: Spec for hero elements (DVT-161, ADR-0027): a headline block for canvas sections. dvt Core (renderer-neutral). eyebrow/headline/subhead support {{ field | agg | format }} variables resolved against the panel's data rows.

eyebrow.description: Small uppercase kicker above the headline.

StatSpec.description: Spec for stat elements (DVT-161, ADR-0027): a single big-number tile (the hero-scale sibling of a metric-strip tile, sharing the same count-up + delta primitive). dvt Core. The DVT-133 scorecard extends these fields rather than forking them.

valueField.description: Data row field reduced to the headline number.

agg.description: How to reduce the column to the headline number. Default sum.

description.description: Optional plain-text explanation of what this metric is and how it's calculated; shown as a hover tooltip.

delta.description: Show a ▲/▼ delta vs the previous period (needs ≥2 rows). Default false.

sparkline.description: Show an inline trend sparkline (needs ≥2 rows). Default false.

valueSize.description: Headline value font size in px. Unset renders the block's default (64 for stat). dvt Core (DVT-1129).

KpiSpec.description: Spec for kpi elements (DVT-133): a grid single-value scorecard — a headline number with an optional period-over-period comparison binding and an optional inline sparkline. dvt Core (renderer-neutral). The hero-scale canvas sibling is `stat`; both share the same count-up + delta primitives. Unlike `stat`, the kpi card carries an EXPLICIT comparison value source (a second column) and an improvement-direction so down-is-good metrics (cost, churn) color correctly. Aggregation is pushed to the warehouse (ADR-0011): the query returns already-aggregated period rows and the card only reduces the small returned series — never a full raw result set client-side.

valueField.description: Data row field reduced to the headline number.

agg.description: How to reduce the value column to the headline number. Default sum.

description.description: Optional plain-text explanation of what this metric is and how it's calculated; shown as a hover tooltip.

comparison.description: Optional period-over-period comparison. With `field`, the comparison value is that column (an explicit second value binding — the prior-period figure your query returns); without it, the previous point of the value series is used (last-vs-prev). The chip colors by IMPROVEMENT, not raw sign.

field.description: Column holding the comparison (e.g. prior-period) value. Omit to compare the last two points of the value series.

agg.description: How to reduce the comparison column. Default: the value `agg`.

mode.description: Show the % change, the absolute delta, or both. Default percent.

improvement.description: Which direction is good — colors the chip green/red semantically. Use `down` for metrics where lower is better (cost, churn, latency). Default up.

sparkline.description: Optional inline trend sparkline (needs ≥2 rows), axes/chrome stripped.

field.description: Series column for the trend. Defaults to `valueField`.

valueSize.description: Headline value font size in px. Unset renders the card's default (36 for kpi). dvt Core (DVT-1129).

MediaSpec.description: Spec for media elements (DVT-161, ADR-0027): an image block. ADR-0014 escape hatch. `src` is SANITIZED before it reaches the DOM (ADR-0027 §2, media-safety.ts): same-origin relative paths, dvt-hosted https assets, and inert raster data URIs only — never an arbitrary remote URL (SSRF/exfil defense for the headless render service).

src.description: Image source. Sanitized: same-origin path, dvt-hosted https asset, or raster data URI.

rounded.description: Corner radius: true → 12px, number → px, false → square.

DividerSpec.description: Spec for divider elements (DVT-161, ADR-0027): a visible rule line. dvt Core. A pure spacer needs no block — leave empty design-space geometry.

inset.description: Inset (px) shortening the rule from both ends. Default 0.

SectionPanelSpec.description: Spec for section panel elements (DVT-469): a named heading band that groups grid panels into labelled sections. The panel title is the heading; an optional one-line subtitle provides context; an optional hairline rule visually separates the section from what follows. Takes no data query. Spans full width (w:24) by convention. dvt Core (renderer-neutral). NOTE: this is the GRID-LAYOUT section panel type (PanelType.section) — NOT the canvas-layout Section block (ADR-0027, layout.sections[]); they are distinct, non-overlapping constructs.

subtitle.description: One-line supporting text displayed below the panel title heading. Optional.

rule.description: Whether to show a hairline horizontal rule below the heading + subtitle. Default true.

align.description: Text alignment of the heading and subtitle. Default left.

RelativeDateEnd.description: One end of a relative-date window (ADR-0028 Amendment 1 A2.3/A7, DVT-256). dvt Core. A signed offset from the resolution anchor ('now', sampled once per request in the author-declared `FilterSpec.timezone`): `{unit, amount, direction}` resolves to a concrete absolute date — e.g. `{unit:day, amount:7, direction:past}` = '7 days ago', `{unit:month, amount:1, direction:future}` = 'one month ahead', `{unit:day, amount:0, direction:past}` = the anchor ('today').
